name: Cariñena
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Cariñena reds have the style of Garnacha from a hot climate.
Its young whites and rosés are best drunk within the year.

blurb.text: An Aragón DO on the Campo de Cariñena plateau. It dates to 1932, one of the oldest DOs in Spain. Its allowed grapes include Garnacha Tinta, Mazuelo, Tempranillo and Syrah.
